signup.title: Join LSES Fighting
signup.lead: Your profile goes public once a listed coach has reviewed it.
signup.consent: I agree that my profile information may be published on the site, and I confirm it is about me.
signup.step1: You sign up on this page.
signup.step2: You fill in your profile on the next screen.
signup.step3Athlete: A coach reviews your profile within seven days.
signup.step3Coach: The general supervisor approves your coach account.
signup.checkEmailText: If {email} can be used, a confirmation link has just been sent to it. Open it to activate your account, then fill in your profile.
signup.checkEmailHint: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder.

login.lead: Log in to manage your profile or handle review requests.

reset.lead: Enter your account email: we will send you a link to choose a new password.

welcome.athleteText: I practise sambo or MMA and want my public profile.

profile.birthDateNote: Your date of birth is never published. It is only used to know whether a legal guardian's consent is required.
profile.lockedNote: Published profile: last name, first names, sex, discipline and date of birth can no longer be changed. If something is wrong, contact the general supervisor.
profile.lockedNoteCoach: Approved account: last name and first names can no longer be changed.

palmares.note: You can fill in your record now or later. Any entry added after publication stays hidden from the public until a coach has reviewed it. The rest of your profile stays online.

photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. The image is resized automatically and its metadata (location, device) is removed before upload.

publication.footnote: Until it is reviewed, your profile does not appear on the public site.
